name: The Order
description: A white-aligned military and religious group across Otaria, with human nomad and aven warrior members, split into Northern and Southern branches.

description_citations.text: "The Order". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chainer fights off Order guardsmen on his way to the Patriarch and earns the First's favor.

citation.text: "Chainer", section "Cabalist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During a dragon attack on the city, Chainer defends the Mirari vaults and uses Death Bloom to shatter a golem and kill Order troops, after his friend Deidre dies.
timeline.quote: Chainer tapped into the ambient power of the Mirari and unleashed the Death Bloom spell, shattering the golem and killing the Order troops.

citation.text: "Chainer", section "Caster". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kirtar uses the Mirari to crystallize much of the Order's fortress, including himself and Captain Pianna; Laquatus ends up with the Mirari.
timeline.quote: Kirtar used the device to cast a devastating spell that crystallized much of the fortress

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Kamahl's Odyssey". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl is badly hurt in the Order's attack on Cabal City and wakes with snakeskin grafted by Chainer using the Mirari; he burns it off.
timeline.quote: To cleanse himself of the additions, Kamahl burnt off his skin and left the hospital

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Kamahl's Odyssey". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kirtar claims the Mirari to destroy it but is corrupted and uses it to kill Pianna.
timeline.quote: Instead, he took it to the Order's citadel and used it to kill Pianna

citation.text: "Mirari", section "Discovery". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kirtar's uncontrolled spell devastates the citadel and kills him.
timeline.quote: Kirtar was unable to end his spell, which went on to devastate the citadel and kill the Lieutenant.

citation.text: "Mirari", section "Discovery". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Order strives to break the Cabal's iron fist over the populace.
timeline.quote: strives to break the Cabal's iron fist over the populace

citation.text: "Odyssey", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chainer fills the central arena with dementia beasts, routing the Order's attack; Kamahl is seriously injured.
timeline.quote: the Order broke off its attack and fled the city.

citation.text: "Chainer", section "Dementist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Mirari games an Order justiciar and angels attack; infuriated, Chainer taps the dementia space of almost every caster on Otaria, unleashing carnage in Cabal City.
timeline.quote: brought all the creatures he found there into existence inside Cabal City.

citation.text: "Chainer", section "Dementist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Laquatus, trapped by Llawan's mages and failing diplomatically with the Order and the Cabal, goes to the mainland with Burke to retrieve the Mirari.
timeline.quote: Laquatus and his jack Burke go personally to the mainland to retrieve the Mirari

citation.text: "Judgment (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: An Order contingent led by Eesha and a Cabal battalion led by Braids head to the mountains while Laquatus plays them against each other.
timeline.quote: Laquatus tries to play them against each other while pretending to be a friend of both.

citation.text: "Judgment (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: An unknown assailant attacks the camps in the forest and the Order leader is killed, blamed on the Cabal, which leaves.
timeline.quote: An unknown assailant begins to attack the camps, and the Order leader is killed, but the blame is given to the Cabal.

citation.text: "Judgment (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kirtar organizes a coup, demands command of the Order and uses the Mirari to engulf Pianna in crystals.
timeline.quote: Kirtar used the Mirari on Pianna, creating a wave of crystals that engulfed her.

citation.text: "Kirtar", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The spell spreads out of control; Turg steals the Mirari and Kirtar fades to nothing as the spell drains his essence.
timeline.quote: Kirtar faded away to nothing as the spell drained away his very essence to feed itself.

citation.text: "Kirtar", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Order sought out and destroyed dangerous artifacts such as the Mirari, repeatedly conflicting with Kamahl.
timeline.quote: the Order repeatedly conflicted with Kamahl

citation.text: "The Order", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kirtar destroyed the Northern Order's citadel, killing much of its leadership including Pianna and Teroh; the Northern Order largely fell apart.
timeline.quote: the Northern Order largely fell apart

citation.text: "The Order", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
